landingPage.headline: En agent, der udfylder dine formularer med størst indsats og viser sit arbejde først.
landingPage.subheadline: Sherma læser formularen, øver fyldet mod en tvilling af den, spørger kun, hvad den ikke allerede ved, og viser dig præcis, hvad der vil blive indsendt. Intet når den rigtige form, før du siger det.
featureTags: Det, du godkender, er det, der går ind

heroDemo.demoNote: Kun illustrativ simulering · Der bruges ingen reel portal eller personlige data
heroDemo.openingReply: Hej, jeg er Sherma. Hvilken formular vil du gerne have hjælp til?
heroDemo.greetingReply: Hej, jeg er Sherma. Hvilken formular vil du gerne have hjælp til?
heroDemo.instructionReply: For at komme i gang skal du uploade skærmbilleder af den formular, du ønsker udfyldt. jpeg, png eller webp · op til 6 billeder. Jeg vil udtrække spørgsmålene og fortælle dig, hvad jeg stadig mangler.
heroDemo.reviewReply: Her er tvillingen. Det er komplet, kontrolleret og stadig adskilt fra live-formularen. Det, du godkender her, er det, der udfører, felt for felt.
heroDemo.approvedReply: Godkendt i demoen. Den nøjagtige godkendte tvilling er klar til at udføre, og hvert felt beholder sin kilde.
heroDemo.escalatedReply: sendt tilbage sikkert. Der skete ingen arkivering.
heroDemo.fallbackReply: Jeg beder kun om oplysninger, der virkelig mangler. Bed mig om at vise manglende felter eller se tvillingen.

principle.heading: bygget til at være tillid til. styret af simulering.
principle.body: Hver formular bliver øvet, før den bliver udfyldt. Sherma bygger en tvilling af den rigtige form, arbejder hele fyldet mod den tvilling og viser den til dig komplet. Den tvilling, du godkender, er den, der henretter. Ikke et resumé af det, ikke en beskrivelse af det. De samme felter, de samme værdier, i samme rækkefølge.
principle.traceBody: Bygget til arkiveringer, der ikke har råd til at tage fejl, ikke demoteater.

principle.guaranteesHeading: Seks ting, der forbliver sande på enhver form.

guarantees.title: omfattet af den form, den blev givet
guarantees.body: Sherma rører ved formularen og de optegnelser, du har tildelt den. Intet andet i dine systemer er i omfang.

guarantees.title: øvet før det er ægte
guarantees.body: Hele fyldet sker først på en tvilling. Live-formularen røres én gang, med et svar, der allerede vides at være komplet.

guarantees.title: Menneskelig godkendelse på tidspunktet for ingen tilbagevenden
guarantees.body: Alt vendbart kører automatisk. Alt, der ikke kan fortrydes, venter på en person.

guarantees.title: tvillingen er planen
guarantees.body: Det du godkender er byte for byte, hvad der bliver indsendt. Hvis formularen ændres nedenunder, er godkendelsen ugyldig, og den kommer tilbage til dig.

guarantees.title: Hvert svar har en kilde
guarantees.body: Hvilket dokument, hvilken kollega, hvilken dato. Hvis nogen spørger om en figur senere, kan du vise, hvor den kom fra.

guarantees.title: Eskalering, aldrig tavs fiasko
guarantees.body: Manglende data bliver ikke gættet. Sherma finder, hvem der ved og spørger, ved chat eller ved opkald, og fortæller dig, om det sidder fast.

impact.heading: Flyt filen fra dit skrivebord, ikke væk fra din radar.
impact.body: Arbejdet holder op med at være noget, en person gør og bliver noget, en person godkender. Det er hele forskellen.

items.title: svar én gang, genbrug overalt
items.body: Det, du bekræfter, bliver en del af din journal. Den næste strukturelt lignende form starter for det meste besvaret.

metric.label: Felter udfyldt uden at spørge dig
metric.note: Første form, femte form, tyvende form. illustrativ.

items.title: Deadlines holder op med at være en scramble
items.body: Sherma arbejder natten over og i weekenden. De sidste otteogfyrre timer er til gennemgang, ikke at samle.

items.title: kontrol holdes, ikke handles væk
items.body: simulering, en eksplicit godkendelse og en registrering af hver handling. Intet fyrer uden dig.

process.heading: Hvordan Sherma udfylder en formular, start til slut.
process.body: Seks trin. Sherma kører fire af dem uden at spørge. De to markeret for en person er de to, hvor afgørelsen ikke kan afsiges.

steps.title: indtag
steps.body: En formular-URL, en videresendt e-mail eller en portal, Sherma ser på. Den samler formularen op og åbner den.

steps.title: Simulering
steps.body: Sherma bygger en tvilling af formen og arbejder hele fyldet mod den. Feltregler, betingede sektioner og dokumentkrav dukker alle op her, ikke ved deadline.

steps.title: Fyld fra hvad den ved
steps.body: Din rekord svarer på det meste. Hver værdi bærer sin kilde, så du kan se, hvor en figur kom fra, og hvornår den sidst blev bekræftet.

steps.title: Spørg efter hullerne
steps.body: kun hvad den virkelig ikke ved. ved chat, eller ved opkald, hvis det haster, og ingen har svaret. Den jagter, indtil den har svaret.

steps.title: Bekræft tvillingen
steps.body: den udfyldte formular, som den vil blive indsendt. Skift hvad du vil, og godken det derefter. Dette er point of no return, så det er dit.

steps.title: Udfør og optag
steps.body: Sherma udfylder den rigtige formular med den godkendte tvilling og returnerer en registrering af hvert felt. Hvor en portal har brug for et personligt login, giver den den færdige formular til dig, som du kan sende.

useCases.heading: Bygget til de former, der ikke har råd til at tage fejl.
useCases.body: Samme agent, samme princip. Det, der ændrer sig, er den post, den trækker fra, og den portal, den modarbejder.

items.title: 營業稅 — Indirekte skatteindberetning
items.body: 營業稅 · 營業稅申報書 — Tilbagevendende indirekte afgiftserklæringer, udarbejdet fra fakturaerne, der allerede er i indbakken, ved hjælp af den samme kontrollerede arbejdsgang for hver rapporteringsperiode og klient.

items.body: Hver køber og transportør har deres egen portal. De samme firmaoplysninger, certifikater og politikker, indtastet fra bunden for hver enkelt.

items.body: Markedsføringsmidler og andelskrav med bevis for ydeevne, et leverandørformat ad gangen, hvor manglende vinduet betyder at miste tildelingen.

items.title: Forsikringsskemaer
items.body: Fornyelser og placeringer, der er forudsigelige, evidenstunge og for det meste uændrede fra den sidst godkendte indsendelse.

items.title: Tilbud, tilskud og arkivering
items.body: Udvælgelsesspørgeskemaer, finansieringsansøgninger og arkiveringer, der gentager organisatoriske beviser, mens hver deadline forbliver endelig.

workedExample.body: Det samme princip, anvendt på den mest gentagne form, der findes. Én skabelon, én enhed ad gangen, fire gange om året, for altid.
workedExample.before: Nogen samler figurerne, indtaster dem i returneringen, tjekker dem i forhold til hovedbogen og arkiverer inden deadline. Hvert kvartal, for hver klient, med intet videreført undtagen et regneark.

control.heading: autonomi uden at miste ansvarlighed.
control.body: AI først ved hvert trin. En person kommer ind i det ene øjeblik, der ikke kan fortrydes, og først da.

points.title: Alt vendbart er automatisk
points.body: læse, simulere, fylde, jagte, samle. Der kræves ingen godkendelse til arbejde, der blot kan laves om.

points.title: Alt irreversibelt stopper
points.body: Indsendelse er point of no return, så det venter på dig. Hvor en portal har brug for en personlig legitimation, holder du den, ikke Sherma.

points.title: den tvilling, du godkender, er den, der kører
points.body: Hvis live-formularen ændres, efter du har godkendt, er godkendelsen ugyldig, og den kommer tilbage til dig i stedet for at udføre alligevel.

points.title: fastlåst er en stat, ikke en stilhed
points.body: Hvis Sherma ikke kan afslutte noget, fortæller det dig, hvilket felt og hvorfor, med tid tilbage til at handle på det.

roiCalculator.heading: ROI Calculator
roiCalculator.subheading: A typical filing desk: 208 review-ready forms. Switch to Base if you start smaller.
roiCalculator.disclaimer: A scenario built from typical form-preparation usage, not observed results. Sherma prepares and corrects; a person still files. This is not automatic live filing or guaranteed acceptance.

currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.breakdown: How the all-in AI cost is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Model form preparation, corrections and human review—not automatic live filing or guaranteed acceptance.
copy.costIntro: Typical token consumption and the platform fee are prefilled for an average user. Edit them if your usage differs.
copy.valueIntro: This is the modeled output and capacity for that typical usage. Edit the assumptions if they do not match your work.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Operating burden removed (negative productivity) returns capacity. Higher-value work (potential positive productivity) creates economic value only if that capacity is used. Hours alone are not cash savings. Token cost uses a modeled input/output mix, not a provider quote.
copy.formulaLabel: Economic value ÷ operating cost = economic return multiple. Net benefit subtracts operating cost once.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Complete the selected assumptions to calculate financial value.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.

volume.label: Forms prepared each month
volume.help: Count forms your team actually prepares in a typical month, not a peak week annualized.

minutes.label: Minutes to prepare one form today
minutes.help: Active preparation and correction time, not waiting on a portal or the calendar elapsed.

automation.label: Share of that preparation Sherma handles
automation.help: An illustrative share of the hands-on work, not a promise of unattended filing.

review.label: Minutes a person still spends on each form
review.help: Human review still required before anything is filed.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens to prepare one form
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled tokens to extract, fill and check one typical form.

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Extra models and media
model_cost.help: Only image, video or other generation charged separately from token usage. Enter zero if none.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Gabriel platform fee
platform_cost.help: Typical monthly access for this usage package. This is a modeled assumption, not a price quote.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly spending you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One explicit amount, not hours multiplied by salary; exclude any planned-hire saving entered separately.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours kept for advisory review
higher_value_hours.help: Hours your existing team can spend on clients instead of re-keying.

contribution_rate.label: Contribution of that advisory hour
contribution_rate.help: Incremental value of an hour of reviewer time on client work, not a salary saving.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

burden: Chasing missing fields and correcting errors

outcomes.label: Keep reviewers on advisory work
outcomes.help: Use returned capacity for client review and advice, not for re-keying forms.

tabs.label: Forms this month
tabs.intro: How many forms a typical desk prepares, how long each one takes today, and the share Sherma can take on before a person reviews.

tabs.label: Token usage
tabs.intro: Tokens to prepare one form, plus the Gabriel fee for this package. Extra tools stay at zero unless you pay for them separately.

tabs.label: What you keep in-house
tabs.intro: Returned hours stay with your reviewers and advisors. This is capacity, not a payroll cut.

cta.privacyNote: Your data stays private. Hours are capacity. Financial amounts are modeled estimates, not observed results.
